status: preimplementation review contract; no model or input read
input_membership: Query IDs must exactly match parent ordinary training/held ID order; donor bank may retain raw rule-handled departures because only input fields are consumed.
Training donor months equal the outer fold allowed list, never a contiguous min/max date span; held context adds only its own held month.
Every query removes all equal-ID occurrences, known same-hex aliases within120s and exact known signature aliases before deterministic topK.
Missing aircraft identities never compare equal; inclusive +/-1800s endpoint and exact tie ordering are tested.
Raw departure BLOCK/y and predicted outputs absent from donor projection; poisoned forbidden fields cannot alter membership or values.
Original AOBT, source time, stand/runway and view identity must match cached source index keyed by own-view IDs; source projection retains no training label dependency.
Old/final overlapping IDs are independent namespaces with different takeoff jitter/identity missingness honored.
encoder_tests: Original backbone parameters, train/eval outputs, backbone gradients and Torch CPU/CUDA dropout RNG exactly equal at zero context initialization.
Nonzero-head complete donor permutation leaves output and inverse-permuted donor gradients equal within documented small float reduction tolerance.
Permutation covers donor tokens, relative geometry, masks and all derived paired fields together.

Equal-marginal pairing contrast uses raw clocks[600,1800], physical[600,1800] versus[1800,600] and recomputes paired differences. A deterministic nonzero model fixture distinguishes the two; zero-head equality is not evidence against pairing sensitivity.
0,1,16donor cases and padded finite-value poisoning cannot create outputs from absent peers.
Empty own track with valid peers remains eligible for context; no peers always returns parent even with deliberately nonzero head.
Scales fixed from physical units; masks distinguish missing values from actual zeros; no held-fitted normalization.
Batch gather maintains per-donor tuple alignment and source-row permutation invariance.
calendar_fixtures: Near-boundary held-month donor is absent for a training query even if within30minutes.
July fold uses Jan/Feb/Mar/Sep/Oct/Nov/Dec as training months; April–June/August cannot enter by date-range expansion.
January held context may include only allowed Mar–Nov plus January, not February/December.
No cross-year or old/final namespace donor accidentally shares an integer ID.
no_new_scientific_choices: These checks validate the fixed design; they do not introduce features, thresholds, scope gates or extra training.
